title: Fourteen information charts in a quadratic field tower

claims.statement: For the binary encoder (a,b,ab,a^3+lambda*b^3) in the fixed quadratic field tower and the stated decoder with fourteen information charts, the average block error for a uniform 1000-bit message on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 11166727434631111/200000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check the degree-250 base field and quadratic tower, exact admitted volume and error, operation and memory bounds, and sample ordinary and split chart identities and direction updates.
